caption: : Video type distribution.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of video types represented in a dataset. The chart contains twelve slices, each representing a different category of video content. The largest slice, colored pink, represents “People,” occupying approximately 17.2% of the total. Following this is “Blogs” at roughly 9.7%, “Entertainment” at 13.9%, “Film Animation” at approximately 4.6%, and “Music” at 4.8%. The remaining slices are labeled “Comedy,” “Travel Events,” “News,” “Politics,” “Science,” “Technology,” “Gaming,” “Sports,” “Vehicles,” “Animals,” and “Pets,” colored in shades of blue and green, respectively, with estimated proportions ranging from 2.3% to 6.6%. Percentage labels are visible within each slice and a legend is not included.  The segments appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their arc size.
